name: parcelflow
title: ParcelFlow
description: Cloud ELT pipeline + parcel volume forecasting — Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Blob, SARIMA, Streamlit
highlights: Idempotent ELT pipeline ingesting 695K synthetic shipment rows across 731 daily partitions and 15 hubs into a star-schema warehouse.
14-day SARIMA forecaster that beat a seasonal-naive baseline by ~16% MAPE (14.1% vs 16.8%).
Data-quality stage quarantining 16,081 bad rows (2.3%) with reasons, plus a run log for observability.

name: damagescan
title: DamageScan
tagline: Parcel damage detection with CNN transfer learning
description: Parcel damage detection — PyTorch transfer learning, Grad-CAM, ONNX, FastAPI
highlights: End-to-end parcel-damage image classifier with PyTorch transfer learning (ResNet-18 vs MobileNetV3) — 93% test accuracy, 1.00 precision on damaged parcels.
FastAPI + ONNX /predict endpoint and a Gradio demo, with Grad-CAM heatmaps confirming the model attends to the parcel, not the background.
Reproducible pipeline: stratified splits, deterministic cuDNN, 7 automated tests, GitHub Actions CI (ruff + pytest), packaged in Docker.

name: docutrack-ai
title: DocuTrack AI
tagline: RAG assistant for shipping & customs documents
description: RAG assistant for shipping & customs documents — LangChain, FAISS, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Streamlit
highlights: Retrieval-augmented Q&A service (FastAPI, FAISS, sentence-transformers) over shipping & customs docs.
LLM invoice-extraction endpoint parsing commercial-invoice PDFs into structured fields.
Anti-hallucination confidence guard with a switchable LLM backend (Gemini).

name: shipsense
title: ShipSense
tagline: Parcel delivery ETA prediction & route optimization
description: Parcel delivery ETA prediction & route optimization — Spring Boot, FastAPI, scikit-learn, React, PostgreSQL, Docker
highlights: Layered Spring Boot API (controller/service/repository, JPA, global error handling).
Python ETL + scikit-learn training pipeline (50k synthetic rows → 49k cleaned) for ETA prediction.
Dijkstra-based route optimization with a React + TypeScript frontend, containerized with Docker.

name: hrflow
title: HRFlow
tagline: HRMS workflow engine with approvals, RBAC & audit trail
description: HRMS workflow engine: configurable approval hierarchies, RBAC, audit trail, country leave rules, payroll webhook integration
highlights: Spring Boot 3 HRMS engine with data-driven multi-level approval workflows across 3 request types, JWT auth and service-layer RBAC over 16 REST endpoints.
Append-only audit trail and a per-country leave-rule engine (India/UAE/Germany), covered by 27 Java tests on embedded Postgres plus 4 Python tests.
HMAC-SHA256 signed payroll webhooks with retries + delivery log, and an idempotent CSV employee importer with row-level validation.

name: peoplepulse
title: PeoplePulse
tagline: People-analytics MIS + guard-railed GenAI HR assistant
description: People analytics MIS + guard-railed GenAI HR query assistant + n8n onboarding automation (synthetic HRIS data)
highlights: People-analytics MIS on a PostgreSQL/SQLite star schema with 10 SQL models.
Guard-railed GenAI natural-language-to-SQL HR assistant (sqlglot validation + allow-listing).
Out-of-time attrition-risk model (logistic regression + gradient boosting), with Streamlit + Power BI (DAX) dashboards and an n8n onboarding automation.

name: adpulse
title: AdPulse
tagline: PySpark campaign analytics — segmentation, A/B testing & BI
description: PySpark campaign-analytics pipeline with K-Means segmentation, A/B testing and Excel/Power BI reporting (synthetic data)
highlights: PySpark ELT over 2M synthetic ad-impression rows, quarantining 1.5% dirty records and computing CTR/CPA/ROAS by channel/region/month via Spark SQL.
A/B test validated with a two-proportion z-test — +11.7% conversion lift (p=0.028) — with a chi-square cross-check and power analysis.
Segmented 50K customers via RFM + K-Means (k=3, silhouette 0.45), isolating a 17K Champions cohort ($627 avg LTV).
